text:
Marta: quick sync — product wants to start announcing sunsetting of api v2 in ~90 days. we need an "escape hatch" plan for customers that can’t upgrade immediately. ideas?
Sam: do we mean a runtime-compatible header-based fallback or a true translator sidecar?
Marta: leaning header toggle for fast opt-in + sidecar for long-term customers who need protocol translation.
Ingrid: header toggle is lowest lift. add a req header like `X-RW-Compat: 2->4` and have routing layer rewrite shape to v4. returns 200 + telemetry.
Jia: header-route approach ok but watch streaming cases and websockets — non-trivial. sidecar needed for streaming/gRPC.
Sam: agreed. header will cover the majority (sync text endpoints). streaming/wss we detect and route to the translator pool.
Marta: what about auth/tenant isolation? translators will need tenant context but we can't let them touch KMS keys.
Ingrid: translator sidecar runs in same pod/tenant VPC, uses short-lived tokens from control plane. no KMS access. only transforms request/response body.
Jia: rollback story: if translator fails we fallback to a fallback-model-route that returns a structured error explaining upgrade steps + link to migration doc. reactions: :warning:
Sam: want automated opt-out if we see >1% error spike per tenant for 5m. trigger = circuit breaker + incident alert.
Marta: telemetry: capture `compat_header_used:true`, `translator_latency_ms`, `translator_error_type` in route-level metrics. we need these for billing and migration dashboards.
Ingrid: config prototype: ```yaml
compatibility:
  header: "X-RW-Compat"
  header_values: ["v2-to-v4"]
  translator:
    enabled: true
    pool: translator-small
    failover_route: /error/compat-upgrade
```
Jia: note: translator pool must be autoscaled based on prefix cache pressure — heavy KV-copying otherwise. also prefer async transform for large payloads.
Sam: security note: sanitize transforms to avoid accidental field mapping that surfaces PII. add transform whitelist config per tenant.
Marta: timeline proposal: enable header-toggle for opt-in in 2 weeks behind `compat-toggle` feature flag, enable translator pool in 4 weeks, start deprecation emails at 30d mark.
deploy-bot: deploy queued -> infra:compat-header-gateway-v1 at 1766235600 by Sam
Ingrid: open question — do we expose the header to SDKs or keep server-side only? exposing makes adoption faster but increases client surface.
Jia: expose in SDKs but default-off, with a clear migration helper that verifies shape.
Sam: next actions: 1) eng-platform to PR header detection + rewrite rule (owner: Sam) 2) eng-infra to create translator pool runbook + autoscale (owner: Ingrid) 3) eng-ml to add sample transforms + regression tests (owner: Jia) 4) docs + SDKs update (owner: Marta)
Marta: thanks — I'll create the RFC follow-up and schedule a 30m sync after infra design is ready. :thumbsup:
